en_title: The Last of Us Gets Animated Background on PS5 as Naughty Dog Teases Announcements for TLOU Day 2026
cn_title: 顽皮狗预告《最后生还者》日惊喜
subtitle: 先来点小惊喜
opus_summary: 顽皮狗为PS5欢迎中心推出免费的《最后生还者》动态背景，并预告9月28日公布更多庆典消息，包括合作伙伴公告、联动、数字惊喜和慈善直播。《最后生还者》第三季也将迎来新演员。

paragraphs.en: Naughty Dog has released a free background on PlayStation 5 as it prepares to celebrate The Last of Us Day 2026.
paragraphs.cn: 顽皮狗推出了PS5免费背景，为庆祝2026年《最后生还者》日做准备。

paragraphs.en: The studio behind Sony's exclusive post-apocalyptic video game franchise took to social media to tease some of what it has planned for this year's festivities. While September 26 is technically the day it's chosen to serve as its Cordyceps-breakout holiday, Naughty Dog won't share any The Last of Us announcements with fans until Monday the 28th, but that doesn't mean there's nothing to fawn over today.
paragraphs.cn: 这家负责打造索尼末世题材独占游戏系列的工作室在社交媒体上预告了今年庆典的一部分安排。虽然9月26日严格来说才是他们选定的「真菌爆发纪念日」，但顽皮狗要到28日星期一才会向粉丝公布《最后生还者》的消息。不过，这并不代表今天没有值得期待的内容。

paragraphs.en: PS5 owners can now head to their consoles to download a special The Last of Us-themed background for PlayStation's Welcome Hub landing page. It's a free option featuring both the younger and older versions of Ellie from both mainline games, with no download required to enjoy it. Although it's far from the kind of dynamic themes or wallpapers fans have begged Sony to bring back, the animated background does add some flavor for fans still hoping to see the series get a proper return in games.
paragraphs.cn: PS5用户现在可以打开主机，为PlayStation欢迎中心主页下载特别的《最后生还者》主题背景。这是一项免费内容，展示了两部正传游戏中年幼与年长时期的艾莉，而且无需额外下载即可使用。虽然它远不及粉丝一直请求索尼回归的那类动态主题或壁纸，但对于仍希望该系列以游戏形式正式回归的粉丝来说，这张动态背景也算增添了几分气氛。

paragraphs.en: We'll be celebrating #TLOUDay on Monday, but we do have a fun surprise for you today. 🧡🩵
paragraphs.cn: 我们将在星期一庆祝#TLOUDay，不过今天也为大家准备了一个有趣的小惊喜。🧡🩵

paragraphs.en: For the first time ever, a The Last of Us-themed background is being added to the PlayStation Welcome Hub. Log in to your PlayStation account and download it to see how our team has… pic.twitter.com/aK6F85FM2I
paragraphs.cn: PlayStation欢迎中心首次加入《最后生还者》主题背景。登录PlayStation账号并下载它，看看我们的团队究竟……

paragraphs.en: Those who want to spice up their PS5 backgrounds need only to navigate to the Welcome Hub, select the Change Background button in the top corner of the screen, and then select The Last of Us background in the Games tab. It's nothing much, but we'll only have to wait a few more days to hear more about The Last of Us Day celebration.
paragraphs.cn: 想为PS5背景增添些变化的用户，只需进入欢迎中心，选择屏幕上方角落的「更换背景」按钮，再前往「游戏」标签页选择《最后生还者》背景即可。虽然这不算什么大内容，但再等几天，我们就能听到更多关于《最后生还者》日庆典的消息。

paragraphs.en: In a separate post, Naughty Dog promised September 28 will bring even more reveals for the franchise. While it doesn't sound like something like The Last of Us Part 3 will be discussed, the team did promise to share a "partnership announcement, a very cool collaboration, digital surprises, and more." There will also be a No Return charity stream on Twitch.
paragraphs.cn: 顽皮狗在另一篇帖子中承诺，9月28日将为这个系列带来更多消息。虽然目前听起来不像会讨论《最后生还者3》之类的内容，但团队确实承诺将分享「合作伙伴公告、一次非常酷的联动、数字惊喜，以及更多内容」。届时还会在Twitch上举办《No Return》慈善直播。

paragraphs.en: Another surprise announced today was the news that The Last of Us Season 3 on HBO has picked up some new and familiar faces : John Goodman, Laura Bailey, and Ian Alexander. Goodman, a series newcomer and award-winning actor, will play a new character named Joey. Bailey, who played Abby in The Last of Us Part 2 and a nurse in The Last of Us Season 1, will play a Seraphite leader named Elizabeth, while Alexander will play a currently unnamed character after first appearing as Lev in the second game.
paragraphs.cn: 今天公布的另一项惊喜是，HBO《最后生还者》第三季迎来了几位新面孔和熟悉面孔：John Goodman、Laura Bailey和Ian Alexander。作为该剧新演员及获奖演员，Goodman将饰演名为Joey的新角色。Laura Bailey曾在《最后生还者2》中饰演艾比，也曾在《最后生还者》第一季中饰演一名护士；这一次，她将饰演一名名叫Elizabeth的塞拉菲特领袖。Ian Alexander则会饰演一名暂未公布姓名的角色，此前他曾在第二部游戏中以Lev的身份登场。

paragraphs.en: We'll have to wait to see what Naughty Dog has planned for The Last of Us Day 2026. While Sony has yet to confirm a The Last of Us Part 3 as work on its Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet continues, fans are hoping an announcement will arrive sooner rather than later . One comment from creator Neil Druckmann sparked theories about a third chapter in Ellie's story in March of this year .
paragraphs.cn: 我们还得等着看看顽皮狗为2026年《最后生还者》日准备了什么。索尼尚未确认《最后生还者3》的消息，而旗下《星际：异端先知》仍在开发中；粉丝则希望相关公告能够尽早到来。今年3月，创作者Neil Druckmann的一条评论曾引发外界对艾莉故事第三章的猜测。
